title: Upgrade/Rollback Failure Injection Matrix (Private Deployments)
content:
Purpose
- This is the canonical failure injection matrix for Redwood Private upgrade + rollback. It lists scenarios, how to reproduce them in staging/CI, expected behavior (abort vs rollback), and what telemetry/diagnostics should be present.
- Owners should use this matrix to:
  1) decide which scenarios must be gated for GA,
  2) implement automation in the upgrade integration harness (see redwood-private-installer PR #452),
  3) validate runbook instructions + supportability (diagnostics bundle contents in PR #444).

Scope
- Applies to: Private VPC and on-prem/air-gapped installs.
- Upgrade mechanism: installer-driven plan/apply with prechecks, backup primitives, component ordering, validation gates, rollback hooks.
- Out of scope: arbitrary customer GitOps and full cluster recovery after catastrophic infrastructure failure.

Legend / columns
- Phase: precheck | backup | apply(control plane) | apply(runtime) | apply(gateway) | migrations | postchecks | rollback
- Action: abort (no changes applied) | stop+manual (operator intervention required) | auto-rollback (installer triggers rollback plan)
- Automation:
  - CI: scenario is run per-commit in CI harness (nightly or required check)
  - Staging: scenario is reproducible in an internal staging cluster (manual trigger)
  - Beta: scenario validated during beta customer rehearsals (requires PS)
- Environments:
  - VPC: EKS-based reference, uses managed snapshots (where available)
  - OnPrem: k3s/k8s reference, local PV snapshots vary by CSI; air-gapped bundles

Assumptions / invariants (must hold for PASS)
- Upgrade plan is deterministic (same inputs -> same step graph), and plan output is captured in diagnostics.
- No partial upgrade may leave the system in an unrecoverable state without an explicit operator decision (i.e., do not silently continue past failed gates).
- Rollback is only allowed when compatibility policy permits it (e.g., migrations not marked forward-only).
- Diagnostics bundle must include: precheck JSON, upgrade correlation id, step timings, k8s events (namespace-scoped), and last N lines of relevant pod logs.

Matrix (rows)
| ID | Phase | Scenario | Env | Fault injection / Repro steps | Expected outcome | Expected telemetry / diagnostics | Automation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| UPG-FI-001 | precheck | Kubernetes version below minimum | VPC/OnPrem | Set cluster to k8s < supported (or override reported version in test harness). Run `installer upgrade plan` then `apply`. | abort with clear error; no backups taken; no helm changes applied. | precheck report shows failing check + remediation; logs show check id + severity=error. | CI (required) |
| UPG-FI-002 | precheck | StorageClass not found / default missing | VPC/OnPrem | Remove default StorageClass or configure installer to use a non-existent SC; run prechecks. | abort; remediation suggests SC name to set. | precheck JSON includes detected SC list; k8s event scrape in diagnostics. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-003 | precheck | Insufficient disk on control-plane nodes | VPC/OnPrem | Fill node disk (or simulate via harness) until threshold breached; rerun prechecks. | abort; guidance to free space; no attempt to backup. | precheck “disk_free_bytes” metric captured; step not started. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-004 | precheck | Missing RBAC permissions to list secrets in namespace | VPC/OnPrem | Bind service account with reduced RBAC; run prechecks. | abort; error identifies required verbs/resources. | precheck shows permission probe results; diagnostics includes `kubectl auth can-i` output snapshot. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-005 | precheck | Control plane version endpoint unreachable | VPC/OnPrem | Block network to control plane service; run plan/apply. | stop+manual: if version info required, abort with “cannot determine versions”; no apply. | structured log with step=version-discovery; correlation id emitted. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-006 | precheck | Config drift detected (values differ from last known good) | VPC/OnPrem | Modify critical Helm values outside installer (e.g., gateway image tag); run plan/apply with drift detection on. | abort by default; allow `--ignore-drift` (manual acknowledgement) in staging only. | drift diff included in diagnostics; clear list of keys. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-007 | backup | Snapshot permission denied (IAM) | VPC | Remove EC2/EBS snapshot permissions for installer role; run apply. | abort before apply; no component upgrade started; operator sees least-privilege guidance. | backup step result includes AWS API error + action items; step timing emitted. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-008 | backup | Snapshot takes too long / times out | VPC | Inject long-running snapshot (mock API or throttle); run apply with default timeout. | stop+manual OR abort depending on timeout policy; must not proceed to apply without verified backup. | alert candidate: backup_duration_seconds; diagnostics includes timeout config and last snapshot status. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-009 | backup | Backup verification fails (restore probe) | VPC/OnPrem | Corrupt snapshot/backup artifact or force verification probe to fail. | abort; do not apply. | verification sub-step logs; diagnostics includes verification output. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-010 | backup | Not enough free space for local backup archive | OnPrem | Fill volume where installer writes temp tarball; run apply. | abort; remediation to change temp dir / free space. | diagnostics includes chosen temp path, free space numbers. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-011 | apply(control plane) | Image pull failure (bad tag / registry auth) | VPC/OnPrem | Set image tag to nonexistent or revoke registry creds; apply upgrade. | auto-rollback if any control plane changes applied; otherwise stop at gate and prompt operator. | k8s events show ImagePullBackOff; installer logs link to component and chart revision. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-012 | apply(control plane) | Control plane rollout stuck (readiness never becomes true) | VPC/OnPrem | Inject readiness probe failure or block dependency; apply. | auto-rollback to previous chart revision after timeout; service restored within target time. | metric: upgrade_step_duration_seconds; event: rollback_triggered=true; diagnostics includes pod describe. | CI (required) |
| UPG-FI-013 | migrations | DB schema forward-only migration present, then attempt rollback | VPC/OnPrem | Upgrade to version with migration marked forward-only; then trigger rollback (manual or via induced failure after migration). | rollback must be blocked with explicit message; system remains on upgraded version; operator instructed on recovery path. | audit log includes “rollback_blocked_forward_only_migration”; diagnostics includes migration metadata table snapshot. | Staging (GA gate) |
| UPG-FI-014 | migrations | Migration job fails (SQL error) | VPC/OnPrem | Inject bad migration or fail DB connectivity during migration job. | auto-rollback if migration is reversible and no forward-only flag; otherwise stop+manual with clear state. | job logs included; helm hook status captured; correlation id present in control plane logs. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-015 | migrations | DB connection limit exceeded during migration | VPC/OnPrem | Lower DB max connections; run migration with concurrent load generator. | stop+manual OR retry with backoff; must not proceed to gateways until migrations succeed. | metrics: migration_retries_total; logs show backoff schedule; diagnostics captures DB max_conn config if available. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-016 | apply(runtime) | Runtime pods OOM due to mis-sized requests/limits | VPC/OnPrem | Reduce memory limits; apply runtime update. | rollback runtime only (if safe boundary), or full rollback depending on ordering policy; system returns to serving. | events show OOMKilled; step graph shows boundary markers; diagnostics includes values diff. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-017 | apply(gateway) | Gateway rollout starts before control plane ready (ordering bug regression) | VPC/OnPrem | Disable readiness gate in test branch or simulate control plane not ready; apply. | should not happen: upgrade controller must block gateway step until control plane healthy; if forced, rollback gateway changes. | log: "gate:control-plane-ready" must be present; smoke test must fail if ordering violated. | CI (required) |
| UPG-FI-018 | postchecks | Post-upgrade smoke test fails (API 500) | VPC/OnPrem | Inject 500 responses (feature flag) during smoke tests. | auto-rollback to previous known good versions, unless policy forbids (see migrations). | smoke test output included; rollback reason=postcheck_failed. | CI (required) |
| UPG-FI-019 | rollback | Rollback command run with wrong target version (not previously installed) | VPC/OnPrem | Run `installer rollback --to <invalid>` or delete local state cache. | abort rollback; show available rollback targets; no changes. | rollback plan output included; diagnostics includes last known good version discovery. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-020 | rollback | Snapshot restore fails (missing snapshot / permission) | VPC | Delete snapshot or revoke restore permissions; trigger rollback that requires restore. | stop+manual; do not continue with partial restore; provide operator checklist. | restore step logs + AWS error; incident tag candidate “upgrade_related=true”. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-021 | orchestration | Upgrade interrupted mid-step (SIGTERM to installer) | VPC/OnPrem | Start apply, then kill installer process during control plane apply or between steps. Re-run apply. | resume-safe behavior: installer detects in-progress run and offers resume or rollback; no split-brain. | run state persisted; correlation id reused or new run references prior id; diagnostics shows previous run summary. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-022 | orchestration | Loss of connectivity to cluster during apply | VPC/OnPrem | Drop network from runner to k8s API; re-enable after N minutes. | stop+manual; no blind continuation; after reconnect, operator can resume with same plan. | clear log around API timeouts; diagnostics includes last successful step. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-023 | packaging | Offline bundle signature invalid | OnPrem (air-gapped) | Modify bundle artifact after signing; run `bundle import`. | abort import; nothing extracted/applied; error includes fingerprint and verification method. | verification logs included; audit log event “bundle_verification_failed”. | CI (required) |
| UPG-FI-024 | packaging | Offline bundle missing an artifact referenced by manifest | OnPrem (air-gapped) | Remove image tarball/chart from bundle; import + apply. | abort at import or plan stage; show missing items list. | diagnostics includes manifest parse output; fail fast before any apply. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-025 | packaging | Bundle contains newer installer than cluster supports (version skew) | OnPrem/VPC | Attempt apply with installer N+2 against deployment N (unsupported skew). | abort with compatibility error; instruct to use matching installer/bundle. | version matrix printed in error; precheck report includes detected component versions. | CI (nightly) |
| UPG-FI-026 | telemetry | Diagnostics bundle generation fails | VPC/OnPrem | Fill disk or remove permission to write diagnostics tarball location; trigger failure path that should generate diagnostics. | upgrade/rollback outcome must still be correct; user warned diagnostics not captured + alternative collection steps. | log “diagnostics_failed=true”; minimal inline guidance printed. | Staging |
| UPG-FI-027 | telemetry | Missing correlation id propagation in control plane logs (regression) | VPC/OnPrem | Run upgrade with instrumentation disabled (test flag) and validate logs. | should fail CI check: correlation id required for GA. | automated assertion: logs contain correlation id field; link to PR #18544 expectations. | CI (required) |
| UPG-FI-028 | supportability | Precheck JSON output missing remediation hints | VPC/OnPrem | Induce known precheck failure (disk, k8s version) and request `--json`. | should fail validation: remediation field required for severity=error. | schema validation for precheck JSON; sample outputs stored in artifacts. | CI (required) |
| UPG-FI-029 | security | Upgrade/rollback audit log event missing actor | VPC/OnPrem | Trigger upgrade with user identity env var unset; verify audit log. | should still log actor as “unknown” + runner metadata; GA requires non-empty actor in standard flows. | audit log includes who/when/versions/correlation id; validation in tests. | Staging (GA gate) |
| UPG-FI-030 | performance | Backup + upgrade exceeds maintenance window target | VPC/OnPrem | Run with load and large DB; record step durations. | not a functional failure; track as perf regression if > threshold; require alerting and guidance. | metrics: per-step durations; dashboards display p95; diagnostics includes step timing summary. | Staging (weekly) |

Notes / harness implementation details
- CI harness (PR #452) should support:
  - deterministic fault injection toggles per step id (e.g., fail precheck X, fail helm apply, fail migration job)
  - capturing artifacts (precheck.json, plan.txt, step_timings.json, diagnostics.tar.gz) as CI outputs
  - “resume” flows: run apply, kill, re-run apply, assert idempotency
- Where real infra calls aren’t feasible in CI, use shim layers (e.g., snapshot API mocked) but keep at least one staging run per release train that hits real snapshot/restore.

GA gating proposal (must pass before enabling for general Private customers)
- Must be green in CI (required): 001, 012, 017, 018, 023, 027, 028
- Must be validated in staging on real clusters per release: 007, 009, 013, 020, 021

Open questions / TODO
- Define exact timeout defaults for: snapshot create, helm rollout, smoke test; map to stop+manual vs auto-rollback.
- Confirm rollback boundaries for runtime-only failures (UPG-FI-016): is partial rollback allowed in v1 or always full?
- Decide whether drift detection (UPG-FI-006) is hard-blocking for beta or only warning + explicit operator acknowledgement.

Change log
- 2025-02-06 (Leila): added forward-only migration rollback block case (UPG-FI-013) per architecture thread; promoted correlation-id check to required.
- 2025-01-24 (Connor/Sean): aligned expected outcomes with runbook v0.8; added maintenance-window perf tracking row.
